title: Windows UI evolution: Clicking an unassociated file
summary: A blog post exploring how Windows handles the user experience when users click on files without associated applications, tracing the UI evolution of this interaction pattern across different Windows versions.
problem_solved: Documents the UX challenge of gracefully handling unknown file types and how Windows has evolved its approach to this common user scenario.
why_valuable: Provides historical insight into Windows UI design decisions, helping developers and UX professionals understand the rationale behind file handling interactions.
